output.summary: The function fn_08 computes a hash value using a custom algorithm and returns the inverted hash.

claims.text: The function initializes the hash value to 0xffffffff.
The outer loop iterates over each byte in the input data.
The inner loop processes each bit of the current byte.
The function does not modify the input data.
The function writes the result to the output buffer.
The function returns VERA_ERR when the output buffer capacity is smaller than the input length.
The function returns the inverted hash value when the output buffer capacity is sufficient.
